paite: Nineveh kho puakgik. Elkosh mi Nahum kilakna bu,
heading: Nineveh Tung A TOUPA Hehna
english: An oracle about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

paite: TOUPA zaw mullit hat Pathian leh phulak ching ahi; TOUPA'N phu ala a, hehna in adim hi; TOUPA'N amah dou mite tung ah phu ala a, amelmate a ding in hehna akholkhawm hi.
english: Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. is a jealous God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” and avenges. Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

paite: TOUPA alungnel a, nakpi a thilhihthei ahi, mimohte siam atangsak mahmah kei ding; TOUPA'N pingpei leh huihpi ah alampi anei a, meipite akhe a leivui ahi.
english: Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

paite: Tuipi asal a, akangtatsak a, lui tengteng leng akangsak khin a; Bashan gam abah a, Karmel tang leh Lebanon tang paklunte avuai uhi.
english: He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel; and the flower of Lebanon languishes.

paite: Amah ziak in tangte aling ua, mualte azulmang ua; ama ah lei avuak a, ahi leitung leh asung a om tengteng toh in.
english: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

paite: Alung hihlouhna mai ah kua ahia dingh thei a, ahehna thupitak ah kua ahia om thei ding? Ahehna mei bang a sunbuak ahi a, suangpite akekzaksak vek hi.
english: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

paite: TOUPA zaw ahoih a, mangbat ni a kulhkip ahi; amah a aginna uh koih mite athei hi.
english: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

paite: Himahleh tui khang luanglet zang in huai mun manthat vekna atungsak ding a, khomial a amelmate delhlut ding in.
english: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

paite: TOUPA kalh in bang na gel ua? Bei sipsipna atungsak ahi, haksa nihveina atung kei ding hi.
english: What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

paite: Lingnok bang a om in a-uain dawn un diahkawt dimdem bang in om mahleh, buhpawl keu bang mai a hihman vek in a-om ding uhi.
english: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

paite: Nang a pawt mi khat TOUPA kalh a thil gilou ngaihtuahmi, gitlouhna thuhilhmi a-om hi.
heading: Nineveh Pukna
english: There is one gone forth out of you, who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ahat theihtawp un hat mah le uh, tam leng tampi himah le uh, huchipi in leng vatpuk in a-om ding ua, amangthang ding uhi. Hon na hihgim khin mah leng ka hon hihgim nawnta kei ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh: “Though they be in full strength, and likewise many, even so they will be cut down, and he shall pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

paite: Tu'n zaw na kiang a kipan ahakkol ka kitansak ding a, nang gakna khaute ka kitatsak vek ding.
english: Now will I break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

paite: "TOUPA'N na tungtang thu ah thu apia hi, na min chi bang a tuh ahi nawnta kei ding a; na pathiante inn a kipan milim bawltawm leh milim sunte ka hihmangthang ding a; na han ka bawl ding; na gilou ngal a," chi in.
english: Yahweh has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, will I cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

paite: Tangte a tanchinhoih tun a, lemna thu tangkoupihte khe en dih; Aw Judah, na ankuang lui inla, na thuchiamte tangtun in; mi thugina lou in ahon pal paisuak nawn kei ding a; hihmanthat vek ahita hi.
english: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.
